description: Guard 2022/yumi-static against empty ordering arrays that modern MiniZinc rejects during evaluation.
rationale: Some challenge instances leave suction, gripper, or fixture ordering tables empty. Older MiniZinc accepted the model shape, but current MiniZinc errors on max(empty).

replacements.replacement: int: no_suction_picks = if card(index_set_1of2(suction_pick_tasks_orders)) = 0 then 0 else max(index_set_1of2(suction_pick_tasks_orders)) endif;
int: suction_order_lengths = if card(index_set_2of2(suction_pick_tasks_orders)) = 0 then 0 else max(index_set_2of2(suction_pick_tasks_orders)) endif;
int: gripper_order_lengths = if card(index_set_2of2(gripper_pick_tasks_orders)) = 0 then 0 else max(index_set_2of2(gripper_pick_tasks_orders)) endif;
int: no_fixtures = if card(index_set_1of2(fixture_task_orders)) = 0 then 0 else max(index_set_1of2(fixture_task_orders)) endif;
int: fixture_order_lengths = if card(index_set_2of2(fixture_task_orders)) = 0 then 0 else max(index_set_2of2(fixture_task_orders)) endif;

semantics_note: The guards preserve the original maxima when order tables are non-empty and use 0 only for degenerate empty tables that otherwise abort compilation.
